title: After 78 Years — photo caption of Savoy business district
text: AFTER 78 YEARS — A concrete highway and automobiles have replaced the dirt road and horses and wagons that once, dominated this 78-year-old Savoy business district.
notes: Photograph showing Savoy's main business district. Caption at bottom reads: 'AFTER 78 YEARS — A concrete highway and automobiles have replaced the dirt road and horses and wagons that once, dominated this 78-year-old Savoy business district.' Image is low contrast and shows a street scene with storefronts and parked vehicles. No date on clipping; '78 years' reference and automobile styles suggest approximately 1950s if Savoy was founded c.1872.
